topics.title: Domain A1: Communicating Confidently in Real-Life Contexts

outcomes.text: Find the main idea and key details in short spoken texts.
Answer simple questions aloud with clear pronunciation and basic sentences.
Take turns and stay on topic in pair and group discussions.

topics.title: Domain A2: Digital Oral Communication in Multicultural and Multimodal Environments

outcomes.text: Share simple ideas orally with voice notes, video calls and online class tools.
Analyse basic online speaking manners such as turn-taking, respect and clarity.

units.title: Competency B: Reading and Critical Thinking

topics.title: Domain B1: Reading for Fluency and Meaningful Engagement

outcomes.text: Find main ideas, supporting details and simple inferences in texts.

topics.title: Domain B2: Reading Strategies and Text Analysis

outcomes.text: Identify simple inferences, key ideas, details and sequence using evidence.
Form and justify personal opinions about a text with evidence.
Identify cause and effect and tell fact from opinion.
Explain characters, setting, plot, conflict and theme in a story.
Identify a poem's theme and respond personally, noticing imagery, rhyme and repetition.
Identify literary, informational, persuasive, procedural, functional and digital texts and their purpose.

topics.title: Domain B3: Digital and Multimodal Reading

subtopics.title: Types and bias of digital texts

outcomes.text: Identify digital and multimodal texts such as webpages, videos and infographics.
Analyse basic features of credible online information such as author, source and date.
Tell denotative from connotative meanings in simple contexts.
Recognise and interpret common idioms.

subtopics.title: Parts of speech, phrases and clauses

outcomes.text: Identify parts of speech and explain their functions in sentences.
Use simple present, past and future tenses.
Write simple sentences with correct word order.
Use different kinds of conjunctions to link words, phrases and clauses.
Identify active and passive voice and change between them.
Use capitals and end punctuation correctly.

Paraphrase short sentences or passages in your own words.
Summarise informational or literary texts objectively, with main ideas and key details.

topics.title: Domain D3: Writing Process and Revision

outcomes.text: Plan writing with graphic organisers or outlines.
Use teacher and peer feedback to revise drafts.

units.title: Competency B: Reading and Critical Thinking

topics.title: Domain B2: Reading Strategies and Text Analysis

outcomes.text: Explain how imagery, figurative language, tone and diction create meaning.
Identify explicit and implicit meanings using evidence.
Evaluate how informational texts use evidence, generalisation and reasoning.
Evaluate how characterisation, setting, plot, conflict and theme give meaning in short stories and one-act plays.

Analyse how text types reach their purpose through structure, language and tone.

Use semicolons, colons, quotation marks and apostrophes, and capitalise correctly.

units.title: Competency B: Reading and Critical Thinking
